notes.title: LASTFIGHT - 4 NEW MODES / Mac / Linux - v1.02
notes.notes:
This update features 4 all-new modes:

[b]Free for All[/b] - A hectic One-Versus-All mode where the last to survive will be declared the victor.
[b]Ranked (Offline)[/b] - In this mode players battle offline opponents to earn points and fight their way up the ladder.
[b]Endless[/b] - In this ultimate skill test players try to beat as many opponents as possible with only 1 health bar.
[b]Pinball[/b] - Attacks won't do damage. In Pinball the only way to defeat enemies is by launching pinballs at them.

And we are happy to announce that the game is also available on [b]Linux[/b] and [b]Mac[/b] !

And a lot of little fixes and tweaks !

And here is our [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NJUv1JOXXeA] new Trailer [/url] !

notes.title: LASTFIGHT Changelog - v1.01
notes.notes:
Version 1.01

Hey guys !
We are super happy of your feedbacks and we are ready to make some changes to the game !
Right now we are working on new modes for the game that we will release as soon as they are done (should be soon !)

Meanwhile here is our first small update with some fixes:

Gameplay
- Crystal special 0 new does a 3 hit combo (used to do 1hit)
- Crystal neutral attack has a bigger hitbox and can be comboable much more easily
- Chandoo normal combo works as it should (used to get out of the combo after the 2nd hit)
- Chandoo can do much more combos from his attacks to his special
- If you block (without doing a Perfect Block) you can't Perfect Block during the next 15frames. No more spam block for Perfect blocks infinite life
- Dreamer special 3 had damage way too high, it's been fixed

IA
- Some tweak on the IA to make it better

UI
- Some Achievements were impossible, they should be fixed now
- Duke Story didn't have all the good text, it's fixed
- In 2v2, if you are on the ground and hitting a button, an icon appears above your corpse
